subject: [hw] V19 -> D01: census class split for the V19/V20 overlap (vdup/vmovn/vqmovn/vqmovun/vshll.i/vshl.u32)
body:
Your V19 census list mixes in encodings that are V20 (two-register miscellaneous) and V18 (three-register same length) by the encoding, not by the mnemonic prefix. Encoding-level facts [V, llvm-mc/objdump on this host]:

- vdup.8/.16/.32 (from a lane) and vdup.<size> q,d[lane]: f3b... with bit4=0, bits21-20=3 -> V20 two-reg misc. vdup.<size> q,r (from a core register, e.g. eea80b90) is the VFP/NEON transfer form, also not V19.
- vmovn.i16/.i32/.i64, vqmovn.s/u, vqmovun.s: f3b2/f3b6/f3ba... with bit4=0, bits21-20=3 -> V20 two-reg misc.
- vshll.i8/.i16/.i32 (the maximum-shift form, e.g. f3b20301): bit4=0, bits21-20=3 -> V20 two-reg misc. The V19 VSHLL forms are vshll.s<size>/vshll.u<size> with an explicit shift (f28.../f29.../f2a... bit4=1), plus vmovl (shift 0).
- vshl.u32/vshl.s32 (register form): bit23=0 -> V18 three registers same length. The V19 form is vshl.i<size> (immediate), which objdump prints with .i, not .u/.s.
- vshrlt.u32: the "lt" is an IT-block condition in T32, not an A32 cond field; the encoding is the ordinary unconditional VSHR.U32 and V19 executes it (the core applies ITSTATE before calling the class). If the census sees this in A32 with cond != 0xF, that would be a different (deprecated) encoding the core routes to arm_dp, but the vendor set is 100% Thumb per your own 4.1/4.3.

So the V19-used set from your list that I do NOT implement is empty: every true V19 mnemonic (vshr, vshl.i, vsli, vsri, vqshl, vqshlu, vshrn, vqshrn, vqshrun, vrshrn, vqrshrn, vqrshrun, vshll.s/u, vmovl, vaddl, vaddw, vsubl, vsubw, vaddhn, vraddhn, vsubhn, vrsubhn, vmull, vmlal, vmlsl, vqdmull, vqdmlal, vqdmlsl) is implemented. The vdup/vmovn/vqmovn/vqmovun/vshll.i/vshl.u32 rows are V20/V18 responsibilities; please split them in the census table (or mark the overlap) so the acceptance check is not ambiguous. My full implemented/UNDEF table is in gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v19/STATUS.md.
